patch_description: Crossover combining the current best (full-lookahead greedy with multistart restarts and a 25s budget) with the inspiration's insertion-move local search, enhanced with swap moves as well. Reasoning: greedy multistart provides diverse good starting schedules; local search (insertion relocations and adjacent/full swaps) then refines each schedule, escaping greedy's local optima. Time is budgeted per restart (remaining time split across remaining restarts) so every restart gets refinement while still covering many starting points. First-improvement moves keep the search fast; the best schedule found across all restart+refinement passes is returned, which should reduce makespan below 299.
